scenario: LTIM.8.3.2: an unknown COMPUTED format identifier raises a ComputationError and abandons its activation, and it does not halt the engine. `written` writes `e.t` in the format `e.fmt` names; `seen` logs every fact. Fact 1 names `ISO8601` (identifiers are case-insensitive, LTIM.8.2.2): both log. Fact 2 names `rfc3339`, which no runtime registers (LTIM.8.2.1): `written` is abandoned and `seen` still logs, on that pump and on the next fact's. Drives libds's `adapter_ds_to_string` unknown-format arm (DS_FAULT_NOT_REPRESENTABLE) and Mercury's `time_to_string` (`rf_not_representable`); the compile-time literal case is DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_TIME_FORMAT, `dsc.typecheck.ltim_8_3_2_format_errors`.
rules_ds:
schema Ev scope logical:
    id: Int key
    t: Time mutable
    fmt: String mutable

rule written:
    Ev e where e.t.to_string(e.fmt) is not null
->
    log critical "written {e.id}"

rule seen:
    Ev e
->
    log critical "seen {e.id}"
